corpus_stability.reason: The Oklahoma Driver Manual is a periodically revised official edition, so Section Eleven driving tips change at most with new editions.

market_signal.origin_note: market signal is authored in part E

sections.heading: C2 — Confusables and KG hints
sections.markdown:
## C2 — Confusables and KG hints, Driving Tips

FACT_ID: sec11-R01 | anchor: A01
Highs dim at a thousand ahead and six hundred behind, lamps span sunset-plus-thirty to sunrise-minus-thirty, and lows own lit and foul weather [A01].
Why it matters: group beams; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec11-F01 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0059]

FACT_ID: sec11-R02 | anchor: A01
Clutches floor at starts, shifts, and sub-ten stops, feet float free otherwise, and downgrade coasts break the cited statute [A01].
Why it matters: group stick; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec11-F02 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0059]

FACT_ID: sec11-R03 | anchor: A01
Aligned seating, aimed mirrors, cleared decks, and buckled belts ready every trip [A01].
Why it matters: group posture; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec11-F03 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0059]

FACT_ID: sec11-R04 | anchor: A02
Grips span a wheel-third near nine-to-ten-thirty and two-to-four, with elbows kept inside [A02].
Why it matters: group grip; difficulty low; prereq sec11-F03; confusables sec11-F04 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0060]

FACT_ID: sec11-R05 | anchor: A02
Silent exhaust gas betrays itself through drowsy blue tightened faces, and beaten victims need air, rest, and maybe medics [A02].
Why it matters: group carbon-monoxide; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec11-F05 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0060]

FACT_ID: sec11-R06 | anchor: A02
Border crossings pack paper proof, and attention laws bar divided driving [A02].
Why it matters: group trips-and-attention; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec11-F06 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0060]

FACT_ID: sec11-R07 | anchor: A03
Eyes-off, hands-off, and mind-off all kill in the thousands yearly across meals, chats, stereos, and texts [A03].
Why it matters: group distraction-trio; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec11-F07 [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0061]

FACT_ID: sec11-R08 | anchor: A03
Phones pull over, delegate, shorten, and voice-dial, while texts ban everyone and handhelds ban pros [A03].
Why it matters: group phone-rules; difficulty medium; prereq sec11-F07; confusables sec11-F08 [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0061]

FACT_ID: sec11-R09 | anchor: A03
Device distraction kills yearly, and junior licenses fall for handheld non-emergencies [A03].
Why it matters: group device-penalty; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec11-F09 [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0061]

FACT_ID: sec11-R10 | anchor: A03
Hold course through animal strikes, and hunt eye-shine hardest at dawn, dusk, and deer season [A03].
Why it matters: group animals; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec11-F10 [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0061]

FACT_ID: sec11-R11 | anchor: A04
Fatigue breaks trips, and trunks stock light, rubber, water, warmth, tools, and signals [A04].
Why it matters: group kit; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec11-F11 [A04].
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0062]

FACT_ID: sec11-R12 | anchor: A04
Heavy sliding water floats cars at two feet, so flooded pavement stays forever closed [A04].
Why it matters: group flood-physics; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec11-F12 [A04].
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0062]

FACT_ID: sec11-R13 | anchor: A05
Six inches steals cars and topples walkers, so barricades, gauges, and turn-arounds rule floods [A05].
Why it matters: group flood-rules; difficulty medium; prereq sec11-F12; confusables sec11-F13 [A05].
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0063]

FACT_ID: sec11-R14 | anchor: A05
Crashes chain calm, calls, hazards, still victims, cleared minors, swapped papers, photos, silence, and insurer notice [A05].
Why it matters: group crash-duties; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec11-F14 [A05].
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0063]
